subject: Cynosure Labs — post-demo usage projection and peak TPS confirmation
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Chen <emily.chen@cynosure-labs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 11 Jul 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Cynosure Lab demo — projected token shape and peak TPS (follow-up)

Hi Emily — thanks again for taking the demo today. Quick recap and a couple of asks so we can put a clean pricing proposal in front of you: 

What we heard on the call
- Primary usage: real-time session summarization (user-initiated) plus background embedding updates for knowledge syncs.
- Typical session size: ~400–1,200 tokens generated per session (summary + short clarifying turn).
- Org cadence: ~1.8M user sessions/month across product; targeted pilot subset ~150k sessions/month.

Numbers we'd like to validate (can you confirm the ranges?):
1) Expected hosted monthly token volume (generated + input): 100M — 250M tokens/month (you mentioned ~150M as a pilot target)
2) Peak TPS (tokens/sec) during peak business hour: you estimated ~800–1,200 tokens/sec for the pilot tranche — want to lock on a 99th percentile target we can size Dedicated capacity around
3) Desired $/1M token target: you indicated a target around $20–$30 per 1M tokens for the pilot; please confirm whether that band is firm or a starting point.

Next steps I propose
- Emily: confirm token/month range and the 99th percentile peak TPS we should design for (reply inline).
- Jordan/Marissa/Karthik: we'll put together two pricing options for hosted API — (A) conservative: headroom for 1.5x peak; (B) lean: best-effort hosted with fallback to a cheaper quantized model for overflow.
- Attachments: I attached a quick token-estimate workbook and a short pricing options summary.

If it's easier, we can run a short traffic-shape test during your next internal spike window — that gives us empirical peak TPS rather than an estimate.

Thanks — Jordan
Jordan Blake
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
---
Attachment: cynosure_token_estimates.xlsx (spreadsheet)
Attachment: redwood-hosted-pricing-options.pdf (PDF)
From: Emily Chen <emily.chen@cynosure-labs.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: platform@cynosure-labs.com, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 11 Jul 2026 17:41:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Cynosure Lab demo — projected token shape and peak TPS (follow-up)

Jordan — great write-up, thanks. A few clarifications inline: 

1) Pilot token volume: confirmed ~150M total tokens/month (includes prompts + generated tokens + embeddings). That is the working target for our pilot (Q3).
2) Peak TPS: our engineering team measured user-facing bursts and saw ~950 tokens/sec sustained for ~2–3 minutes during a recent marketing campaign. We expect occasional short spikes up to ~1,400 tps for <30s during major product announcements. If you need a 99th percentile, use 1,100 tps.
3) $/1M target: $25/1M is the desired target for trial economics. For a longer commitment we can be flexible toward $20/1M but would need a 6–12 month committed volume.

We can run the traffic-shape test — platform@cynosure-labs.com can coordinate a short window next Wednesday (7/14) at 14:00 PT.

Emily Chen
Head of Platform, Cynosure Labs
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 12 Jul 2026 08:09:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Cynosure Lab demo — projected token shape and peak TPS (internal)

Marissa / Karthik — forwarding Emily's confirm. Key takeaways for pricing:
- Pilot: 150M tokens/month, target $25/1M for trial.
- Design capacity: 99th pctl = 1,100 tps; occasional 1,400 tps spikes for <30s.
- Use case mix: ~70% generation (summaries), ~30% embeddings + meta calls.

Ask: can you sketch two hosted options we can present Wed morning?
Option 1 (Pilot, no commit): Hosted API with autoscaling, soft throttles at 1,100 tps 99th pctl and overflow into a quantized model variant — expected effective $/1M ~ $28 (no commit).
Option 2 (6m commit): Reserved consumption band pricing at $20/1M with a burst overlay to 1,400 tps for short spikes.

Also capture any operational caveats (e.g., KV cache hit assumptions for summarization that materially reduce token counts).

Thanks — Jordan
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 12 Jul 2026 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Cynosure Lab demo — projected token shape and peak TPS (internal)

Adding estimates — draft numbers below, will formalize into a PDF pricing proposal: 

High-level economics (pilot 150M tokens/month)
- Option A (Pay-as-you-go hosted): list price equivalent ~$32/1M; with pilot discount/negotiation expected ~$28/1M. Monthly run-rate ~$4.2k (per 1M) * 150 = ~$4200 * 150? (note: need to use per-1M unit properly — will attach corrected calc).
- Option B (6-month commitment): $20/1M target -> monthly invoiced tokens at committed volume; effective monthly spend at 150M -> $3,000 (per 1M * 150 -> wait — will correct math in attachment).

Operational notes:
- For summarization workloads we assume 30% prompt (input) / 70% generation split; KV caching could cut generation tokens by ~15% for repeat reads.
- For peak TPS sizing we should offer a burst SLA (soft) and recommend a small buffer (10–15%) to keep latency SLOs during cache-miss storms.

I'll produce a concise quote and attach clean per-1M math (numbers corrected) by EOD. Jordan — please confirm the Wed 7/14 14:00 PT test window with Emily so we can capture empirical spikes.

Marissa Cole
Director, Customer Pricing & Renewals, Redwood Inference
